authority_basis: Current root-delegated R99 user authorization: implement the minimal bounded future-feedback coordination and bounded scalar clock probe, complete directed validation, then root may conduct at most one bounded physical round. This is new R99 authority, not inherited R98 physical permission.

implementation_kind: minimal bounded FIFO future-feedback coordination plus scalar clock observation; actual behavior source changes, with separate administrative renewal
required_activation: Root alone, after directed real-chain tests and independent review, exact source/profile/environment freeze, fresh original process/lock/domain/resource admission and explicit launch decision. No runtime is started by this metadata.
window_basis: New operator-chosen finite administrative window for currently authorized R99 work; not a user-imposed hard cutoff and not renewal of expired prior physical permission.
retry_timer_clock: STEADY_TIME, same control owner group, initially cancelled

source_qualification: Default OFF helper/probe selectors; per-round opt-in after directed validation. R98 eleven environment selections unchanged, including eager=1.
physics_launch_owner: root only after directed tests/freeze/fresh admission
hash_binding_note: Authority binds baseline and prior host evidence only. The new proof appends this authority path/bytes/hash; the resource module then binds the new proof hash. Authority does not hash its downstream proof/module/profile.
